race.comment: Keen to see the return of DETERMINED ROSE (10) who was a very impressive winner on debut here back in June, leading throughout in fast time to win well. Since spelled, she's trialled nicely and with a clean getaway she'll be very hard to catch here. LIGHT MOVES (3) resumes. He showed good ability in four runs last time in getting over a touch further. Watch the betting. POL ROGEUR (4) resumes. He went to the paddock off a maiden win here albeit over 1500m. He did run well this trip on debut behind a handy enough horse, look for him running on. CRESTA CRYSTAL (9) resumes with each way claims, she should get a nice enough trail behind the pace.
